profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hi! I'm Elizabeth. Reach out to chat at lizvnguyen (at) gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Owned end to end the design, implementation, and scaling of Pinterest’s first generic storage-side Change Data Capture system for real time analytics for KV Store Database using Apache Kafka Connect and Debezium. https://shorturl.at/uijz8
- Save $200k/yr in Amazon EC2 maintenance costs and engineering hours by consolidating and replacing 3 team-specific custom KV CDCs. Achieve Data Eng OKRs of cost savings by migrating less reliable client-side CDCs and fulfilling a 2 year cross functional OKR of enabling CDC for all KVStore customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Data Infrastructure intern on the Data Transportation team. Built RocksCDC, a new standalone Change Data Capture (CDC) system that captures Change data logs in RocksDb databases using Debezium and Kafka Connect.
- Create the 1st generic CDC system at Pinterest, enabling real time data processing and consolidation of all CDCs.
- Enable distributed storage-side CDC on the KV Store datasets, each composed of 100-300 shards.
- Deployed on a dataset with 340k queries a day, with 0% over delivery and 0% under delivery of messages. 
- Tail on the Write Ahead Log (WAL) of each RocksDb shard's Leader to replicate and send change logs to Kafka in real time with configurable topic specification.
- Ensure high reliability with at least once delivery and Database Leader failover handling to fallback to the host with the highest LSN.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developer for a $42 billion software company. Worked on the Studio Core team on core developer platform features. 

Implemented a globalized window, making the code logic applicable for Http requests on international websites. Used by over 2.5 million new users in China acquired within 2 weeks of launch. Worked directly with the China globalization team.

Developed a user-and-machine-specific cache implementation to replace the machine-specific cache.

Mocked the window class to unit test the non-user-facing logic with a mock http request.

Designed and implemented the entire technical implementation of the project, while working alongside a designer, data science analyst, product manager, engineering manager, and front-end China globalization team.

Organized and hosted a company-wide Women's ERG event. Received approval from Roblox’s Chief Marketing Officer.

positions.title: Software Engineer + Startup Fellow
positions.description:
Competed and won UC Berkeley’s Cal Hacks Fellowship Startup Accelerator at the world’s largest collegiate hackathon (2,500 competitors). Ranked top 8 out of 222 projects. Awarded funding in grants and entry into a startup accelerator.

Developed GradTrak, a web app enabling students to better plan school schedules by tracking graduation requirements.

Designed the entire web app’s UI/UX. Conduct all marketing and outreach. Promoted the app, leading to 1000 accounts and ~3200 engagements. Developed GradTrak’s business model, conducted market research and user interviews. 1 in 34 Berkeley undergrads use our product.

honors.title: UC Berkeley’s Algorithms Class Competition
honors.description:
Competed and ranked 8th out of 239 projects and 635 competitors in Berkeley’s Advanced Algorithms class competition.
Implemented a final greedy algorithm with heuristics, to repeatedly remove random edges along the current shortest path, weighted to minimize the creation of bridges (edges that would cause the graph to be disconnected).
Coded an optimized solution to a nondeterministic polynomial-time complete (NP-Complete) problem, specifically a graph network interdiction problem to remove as few edges and vertices as possible to maximize the shortest path.
